results.title: GORGO: Online Tuning for Cross-Region Network-Aware LLM Serving
results.summary: Proposes GORGO, a proxy for geo-distributed LLM inference that holistically balances network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay to reduce uneven KV-cache concentration across cross-region replicas, reporting 6.9-15.5% p95 TTFT improvements. Revised through July 2026.

results.title: PrefixWall: Mitigating Prefix Caching Side Channels in Shared LLM Systems
results.summary: Introduces PrefixWall, a defense for shared LLM serving that monitors Automatic Prefix Caching reuse across users, flags suspicious sharing, and selectively isolates prefixes to mitigate timing side channels in multi-tenant environments, achieving up to 70% higher cache reuse than full user isolation.

results.title: Selective KV-Cache Sharing to Mitigate Timing Side-Channels in LLM Inference (SafeKV)
results.summary: Presents SafeKV, a system combining privacy enforcement with KV-cache management (three-tier asynchronous detection, radix-tree memory manager, runtime safeguard) to mitigate timing side channels from global KV-cache sharing in multi-tenant LLM inference while preserving throughput; revised February 2026.

results.title: I Know What You Asked: Prompt Leakage via KV-Cache Sharing in Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
results.summary: Foundational NDSS 2025 paper showing that KV-cache sharing in multi-tenant LLM serving frameworks (SGLang, vLLM) enables side-channel attacks (PROMPTPEEK) that reconstruct other tenants' private prompts; defines the threat model for cross-tenant cache leakage.
